metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented end-to-end in Node.js standard library only.

Files:
- [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js)
- [parser.js](/workspace/output/parser.js)
- [recurrence.js](/workspace/output/recurrence.js)
- [utils.js](/workspace/output/utils.js)
- [ical](/workspace/output/ical) (executable symlink to `main.js`)

What’s done:
- `ical parse --input <.ics> --output <.json>`
- `ical expand --input <.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <.json>`
- Full CLI/error contract with exit codes `0/1/2`
- Structural `.ics` parsing with unfolding, params (RFC 6868 decoding), components/properties, warnings, and schema-shaped JSON
- Parsing for VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VALARM/VAVAILABILITY(+AVAILABLE), calendar-level RFC 7986 fields, related-to/conference/image/attachments/attendees
- RRULE parsing (including `RSCALE`/`SKIP` fields in schema), `RDATE`/`EXDATE`/`EXRULE` handling, override logic with `RECURRENCE-ID` and `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`
- Expansion output with sorted `occurrences` and timezone conversion through in-file `VTIMEZONE` observances

Validation run:
- `node --check` passes for all source files.
- Smoke-tested both `parse` and `expand` commands successfully on a synthetic calendar input.
